name: init
description: Establish and converge on a shared repository overview before task-specific planning.

steps.action: Assess repository scale and complexity to determine if Scout reconnaissance is required, or proceed to direct survey.
Perform read-only topological reconnaissance and return a structured scout-survey message artifact to Planner.
Validate scout-survey evidence against repository ground truth (or perform direct repository survey) and draft the initial AGENTS.md artifact.
Review the current AGENTS.md artifact and report missing, ambiguous, or incorrect context.
Incorporate Reviewer feedback into the AGENTS.md artifact.
Review the updated AGENTS.md artifact and report missing, ambiguous, or incorrect context.
Incorporate Builder feedback into the AGENTS.md artifact.
Evaluate whether the current inquiry pass reached consensus.
Finalize and persist the AGENTS.md artifact at repository root.

name: plan
description: Author, review, and lock task-specific build and review plans through the Plan-Review Gate.

steps.action: Author the build-plan and review-plan artifacts for the task.
Submit build-plan and review-plan artifacts to Reviewer for gate review.
Inspect build-plan and review-plan artifacts for clarity, feasibility, scope boundaries, and verification criteria.
Revise build-plan and review-plan artifacts based on Reviewer feedback.
Finalize approved plans and prepare for blind handover.

name: build
description: Execute blind handover, perform mandatory alignment, implement minimal changes, and verify locally.

steps.action: Dispatch the approved build-plan artifact to Builder via blind handover, strictly withholding the review-plan artifact.
Initiate implementation alignment with Planner regarding intent, scope, and edge cases before editing code.
Answer alignment inquiries and confirm scope boundaries and self-testing expectations.
Implement minimal required changes strictly within allowed files and verify with local automated tests.
Hand off the verified working copy diff and test execution logs to Planner without committing.
Inspect working copy diff against in-scope boundaries, verify local test execution, and hand off to Reviewer without committing.

name: review
description: Independently inspect code diff, execute TDD issue reproduction and fix loop, and resolve escalations.

steps.action: Forward Builder's code diff to Reviewer for verification against the review-plan artifact.
Inspect code diff against the review-plan artifact for scope compliance, correctness, and test adequacy.
Forward actionable review-findings to Builder, strictly withholding the review-plan artifact.
Establish a failing reproduction test for the reported finding (application code Out-of-Scope during this phase), then hand off to Planner for baseline verification before proceeding to fix.

Fix application code until all tests pass; frozen test dependency surface must not be modified. Builder may begin Green work only after Planner has recorded the baseline reference and frozen dependency surface under tdd-reproduction; Builder must not report FIX_VERIFIED until Planner has audited the frozen paths. Report resolved diff and test logs to Planner for frozen-path audit and VCS governance.
Summarize review results, confirm acceptance criteria satisfaction (REVIEW_PASS), and advance to the commit flow.
Arbitrate escalation with Reviewer (clarify/waive false positive, or evaluate scope change/plan update for unexpected error).
End the current review cycle and return to the plan flow to revise the task plans.

name: commit
description: Stabilize candidate identity, update living operational memory, perform security scans, and seal revisions under VCS governance upon human authorization.

steps.action: Confirm independent review approval (REVIEW_PASS) and establish candidate baseline.
Await explicit user commit request to initiate persistence.
Query operational caveats from Builder and Reviewer (Reviewer must only report public, independently observable operational facts or 'no publishable caveats').
Update AGENTS.md with synthesized, sanitized caveats and fresh Observed-At provenance metadata.
Conduct narrow visibility and blind-barrier check on AGENTS.md to ensure no review secrets leaked.
Stabilize candidate snapshot identity, verify candidate equivalence, and execute fail-closed secret scan via active security gate mechanism (non-zero exit code halts pipeline).
Present finalized candidate diff and Conventional Commit message, awaiting explicit human commit authorization.
Verify unchanged candidate identity and seal revision locally under Planner VCS governance via active VCS mechanism capability.
Publish sealed revision to remote repository under explicit publication authorization via active VCS mechanism capability.
